set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators InnerProductSpace

theorem prescribed_pair_orthogonal
  (n : ℕ)
  
  (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
  (i j : Fin n)
  (hij : i ≠ j) :
  ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
    y ≠ 0 ∧ ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ = 0 ∧
      ∀ k : Fin n, k ≠ i → k ≠ j → y k = 0 := by
  by_cases hxi : x i = 0
  · refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have hi := congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => z i) h
      simpa using hi

      x j • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) -

    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
